~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw25-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context NOVA22
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_NOVA-LINK22_Subnets
  network-object 10.45.55.160 255.255.255.224
!
access-list NOVA-LINK22_access_in extended permit ip 10.45.55.160 255.255.255.224 any
!
route NOVA-LINK22 10.45.55.160 255.255.255.224 10.45.54.214 1
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ vss-a25-l25 FW context router vss ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
ip route 10.45.55.160 255.255.255.224 10.45.54.25 name NOVA22:BLDC01-WLAN13=NOVA-LINK22
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ vss-a24-l24 building router vss ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 574
  name BLDC01-WLAN13=NOVA-LINK22
!
interface Port-channel72
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 574
!
interface vlan574
  description BLDC01-WLAN13=NOVA-LINK22
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-LINK22
  ip address 10.45.55.190 255.255.255.224
  ip helper-address 10.32.57.4
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
interface Vlan574
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END #############  


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg03-sw01-01 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 574
  name BLDC01-WLAN13=NOVA-LINK22
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 574
!
interface Port-channel50
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 574
!
interface Port-channel3
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 574
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
